label: Supply Chain ESG Risk Screener
description: Assesses ESG risks across the supply chain based on supplier information, geographic exposure, and sector characteristics. Identifies high-risk suppliers requiring enhanced due diligence.

claudeKnowledge.description: Supply chain ESG risk databases, country risk indices, sector risk profiles, CSDDD requirements

guidedInputs.label: Supply chain description
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Describe your supply chain:
- Key categories of suppliers (goods, services, raw materials)
- Estimated number of direct (tier 1) suppliers
- Key geographies where suppliers operate
- Any known high-risk areas (geographies, sectors, commodity types)
- Approximate annual procurement spend by category

options.label: CSDDD (EU Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive)

guidedInputs.label: Known or suspected supply chain risks
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Describe any risks you are already aware of:
- Specific geographies with labour rights concerns
- Commodities with known ESG issues (cobalt, cotton, palm oil, etc.)
- Previous incidents or allegations
- Sectors with elevated modern slavery or deforestation risk

guidedInputs.label: Existing supplier ESG programme
guidedInputs.placeholder:
What supplier ESG measures are already in place?
- Supplier code of conduct
- ESG questionnaires sent to suppliers
- Third-party audits or certifications required
- Supplier training programmes
- Contract clauses for ESG requirements
